title: Rare-earth stocks sinks deeper into the red. Here’s the latest catalyst.
html:
Shares of Trump-backed USA Rare Earth slides 10% as analysts push out their sales estimates

Wall Street sowed doubts about USA Rare Earth on Monday, sparking a selloff that hit other stocks in the rare-earths sector and adding to steep yearly losses for the mining and manufacturing company, which had been a highflier in the early months of 2026.

At the center of the storm was a stock downgrade from analysts at William Blair. USA Rare Earth USAR is facing raw-material shortages, pressuring the stock, the analysts said in a note Monday. They downgraded the shares to the equivalent of neutral, saying they tweaked their sales and profitability estimates for the company.
summary: Shares of Trump-backed USA Rare Earth slides 10% as analysts push out their sales estimates.
